SELECT t1.*, ROUND(100 - SUM(NVL(fcp.prin_amt, 0)), 6) intPrinAmt FROM ( SELECT t8.CASH_ID cashId, t8.CASH_TYPE CASH_TYPE, SUM(T8.QTY)*100 qty, t8.SEC_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, nvl(SAI.SEC_ACCT_NAME, fp.FINPROD_NAME) secAcctName, FPD.COLLECT_TYPE collectType, CASE WHEN SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END channel, t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t10.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, TO_CHAR(t8.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate, TO_CHAR(t8.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate, T10.FINPROD_ID, T10.CCY, T10.ISSUER issuer, ROUND(t8.INT_AMT, 12) unitIntAmt,/*单位应计利息*/ TO_CHAR(T10.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDateWhole,/*起息日*/ TO_CHAR(T10.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDateWhole,/*到期日*/ ROUND(t8.PRIN_AMT, 4) prinAmt,/*还本面额/百元*/ T8.RANGE_YIELD*100 yield,/*区间票面利率（%）*/ TO_CHAR(T8.PAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') payDate,/*支付日*/ TO_CHAR(T8.mdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') tradeDate,/*交易日*/ ROUND(sum(T8.intAmt), 8) intAmtTheory,/*理论应计利息*/ ROUND(sum(T8.prinAmt), 4) prinAmtTheory,/*理论还本金额*/ T10.TRADE_MARKET, ROUND(sum(t8.fpriceAmt), 4) fpriceAmt,/*理论本息总额*/ NULL PA_BUSS_TYPE from (select T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.AMOUNT QTY, listagg(T1.CASH_TYPE, ',') within group ( order by T1.CASH_ID ) CASH_TYPE, listagg(T1.CASH_ID, ',') within group ( order by T1.CASH_ID ) CASH_ID, min(T1.VDATE) VDATE, T1.MDATE, SUM(nvl(T1.CASH_AMT,T1.INT_AMT) * T1.AMOUNT) fpriceAmt, /*理论本息总额*/ sum(case when T1.CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE01}, '04') then 0 else T1.PRIN_AMT * T1.AMOUNT end) prinAmt, max(T1.INT_PRIN_AMT) INT_PRIN_AMT, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, SUM(T1.PRIN_AMT) PRIN_AMT, SUM(T1.INT_AMT) INT_AMT, SUM(T1.int_amt * T1.AMOUNT) intAmt, /*理论利息*/ T1.PAY_DATE, max(t1.RANGE_YIELD) RANGE_YIELD from (SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, DECODE(T1.HODING_TYPE, '06', T1.AMOUNT*-1,'11', T1.AMOUNT*-1, T1.AMOUNT)/100 AMOUNT, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, t2.vdate, t2.mdate, t2.cash_amt, t2.prin_amt, t2.INT_PRIN_AMT, t2.int_amt, t2.cash_id, t2.cash_type, t2.pay_date, t2.RANGE_YIELD FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE T1 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} AND t1.CDATE < t2.MDATE LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE T1.AMOUNT > 0
AND T1.HODING_TYPE = 'A_001' AND T1.DATE_TYPE = 0 and nvl(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') = 'null' AND T1.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId} AND T2.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND T2.MDATE = to_date(#{mDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and T2.CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE01},#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE02},#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE03},#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE04}) and (t2.INT_AMT > 0 or t2.PRIN_AMT > 0) /*不存在生效的交易*/ and NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TPDA LEFT JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON TPDA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where TDTA.MP_FINPROD_ID IS NULL and TPDA.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TPDA.BUSI_TYPE = #{TRD10} AND TPDA.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} and T2.MDATE = TPDA.MDATE AND TPDA.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID =TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND (TPDA.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID OR TPDA.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID)) /*不存在流程中的当期或之前的交易*/ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TPDA LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON TPDA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID where TDTA.MP_FINPROD_ID IS NULL and TPDA.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TPDA.BUSI_TYPE = #{TRD10} AND TPDA.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} and T2.MDATE >= TPDA.MDATE AND TPDA.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID =TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID AND (TPDA.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID OR TPDA.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID))
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE tpsp where tpsp.HODING_TYPE = T1.HODING_TYPE and tpsp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID and tpsp.SEC_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID and tpsp.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID and tpsp.CDATE > T1.CDATE and tpsp.CDATE < t2.MDATE )
) T1 group by T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.MDATE,T1.AMOUNT, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, T1.PAY_DATE) T8 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T10 ON T10.FINPROD_ID = T8.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO SAI ON T8.SEC_ACCT_ID = SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON T8.SEC_ACCT_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPD ON FP.FINPROD_ID=FPD.FINPROD_ID WHERE T10.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} and T10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId} GROUP BY t8.CASH_ID , t8.CASH_TYPE, t8.SEC_ACCT_ID,SAI.SEC_ACCT_NAME, fp.FINPROD_NAME,SAI.SEC_ACCT_ID, t8.PRIN_AMT, t8.INT_AMT/*还本金额*/, t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t10.FINPROD_NAME , t8.VDATE, t8.MDATE, T10.FINPROD_ID, T10.CCY, T10.ISSUER, T10.VDATE, T10.MDATE, T8.RANGE_YIELD , T8.PAY_DATE , T10.TRADE_MARKET, FPD.COLLECT_TYPE ) T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp ON fcp.FINPROD_TYPE2 =#{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} AND fcp.MDATE < to_date(T1.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND T1.FINPROD_ID = fcp.FINPROD_ID and fcp.CASH_TYPE IN (#{CASH_CLASS_TYPE02}) and fcp.PRIN_AMT > 0 GROUP BY t1. cashId, t1.CASH_TYPE, t1.QTY, t1.secManageAcctId, t1.channel, t1.secAcctName, t1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t1.finprodMarketName, t1.vDate, t1.mDate, t1.FINPROD_ID, t1.CCY, t1.issuer, t1.unitIntAmt , t1.vDateWhole , t1.mDateWhole , t1.prinAmt , t1.yield , t1.payDate , t1.tradeDate , t1.intAmtTheory , t1.prinAmtTheory , t1.TRADE_MARKET, t1.fpriceAmt , t1.PA_BUSS_TYPE, t1.collectType

select t1.totle_trade_id as totleTradeId,t1.finprod_id as finprodId, t1.finprod_type2 as finprodType2,t1.ps as ps,t1.trade_date as tradeDate, t1.ccy as ccy,t1.settle_speed as settleSpeed,t1.settle_date as settleDate, t3.faceValue/100 as shareAmt, t3.faceValue as faceValue, t3.sec_acct_id as secManageAcctId,t3.ACCT_NO as acctId, t1.trade_market as tradeMarket,t1.trade_market_mode as tradeMarketMode, t1.tg_busi_type as tgBusiType, t2.exercise_price as exercisePrice,t2.redeem_rate as redeemRate, fcp.int_amt*(#{PLATEFORM_DATE,jdbcType=DATE}-fcp.vdate) as intAmt, fep.ACT_EXERCISE_DATE as actExerciseDate from REG_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 left join reg_fin_product_deal_total_add t2 on t1.totle_trade_id=t2.totle_trade_id left join ( select p.finprod_id,p.sec_acct_id,pc.ACCT_NO,sum(p.amount) as faceValue from PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE p left join PTL_CAPACCT_INFO pc on p.PORTFOLIO_ID=pc.PORTFOLIO_ID and pc.acct_type='A01' where p.HODING_TYPE = #{A_001} and p.DATE_TYPE = 0 and p.cdate=#{PLATEFORM_DATE}-1 group by p.finprod_id,p.sec_acct_id,pc.ACCT_NO )t3 on t1.finprod_id=t3.finprod_id left join FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp on T1.finprod_id=fcp.finprod_id and fcp.cash_type in ('01','04') and fcp.vdate<=#{PLATEFORM_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} and fcp.mdate>#{PLATEFORM_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} left join FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN fep on fep.finprod_id=t1.finprod_id and fep.exercise_date=T1.settle_date and fep.exercise_type='01' WHERE T1.PS = #{psT39} and t3.faceValue!=0 AND T1.settle_date = #{PLATEFORM_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND T1.IS_CANCEL != #{YESNO_Y} and T1.TRADE_MARKET in ('01','02') /*不存在生效的交易*/ and NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TPDA left join trd_product_deal deal on TPDA.totle_trade_id=deal.totle_trade_id left join trd_product_deal_add dealAdd on deal.trade_id=dealAdd.trade_id left join PTL_CAPACCT_INFO pc on dealAdd.PORTFOLIO_ID=pc.PORTFOLIO_ID and pc.acct_type='A01' where TPDA.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TPDA.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} and TPDA.trade_date=#{PLATEFORM_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND TPDA.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID and TPDA.ps=#{psT39} AND TPDA.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = t3.sec_acct_id and t3.ACCT_NO=pc.ACCT_NO
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM TRD_BANK_MANUAL_SETTLE_INFO WHERE SETTLE_STATUS = '02' AND TRADE_ID = TPDA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID) ) /*不存在流程中的当期或之前的交易*/ AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TPDA left join wfl_trd_product_deal deal on TPDA.totle_trade_id=deal.totle_trade_id left join wfl_trd_product_deal_add dealAdd on deal.trade_id=dealAdd.trade_id left join PTL_CAPACCT_INFO pc on dealAdd.PORTFOLIO_ID=pc.PORTFOLIO_ID and pc.acct_type='A01' where TPDA.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND TPDA.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} and TPDA.ps=#{psT39} and TPDA.trade_date=#{PLATEFORM_DATE,jdbcType=DATE} AND TPDA.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND TPDA.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID = t3.sec_acct_id and t3.ACCT_NO=pc.ACCT_NO )

select * from (SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, sum(T1.AMOUNT) as faceValue, sum(T1.AMOUNT) /100 as shareAmt, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID as secManageAcctId FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE T1 INNER JOIN fin_exercise_plan T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F01} AND t1.CDATE = t2.exercise_date-1 and t2.exercise_type='01' left join PTL_CAPACCT_INFO pc on T1.PORTFOLIO_ID=pc.PORTFOLIO_ID and pc.acct_type='A01' WHERE T1.AMOUNT != 0 AND T1.HODING_TYPE = #{A_001} AND T1.DATE_TYPE = 0 AND T2.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND t2.exercise_date = #{cdate,jdbcType=DATE} and T1.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{SEC_ACCT_ID} and pc.ACCT_NO= #{ACCT_NO} group by T1.FINPROD_ID,T1.PORTFOLIO_ID,T1.SEC_ACCT_ID)aaa where aaa.faceValue!=0
mapper.insert: insert into trdquto_match_info (SEQNO, CSTP_TRADE_ID, EXE_ID,TRD_ID, PRE_TRADE_ID, MATCH_TYPE, MATCH_STATUS, TRD_CONF_STATUS, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME ) values (#{seqno,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cstpTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{exeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{trdId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{preTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{matchType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{matchStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trdConfStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sysdate, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR},sysdate )
mapper.select: SELECT P.ACCT_NO CASHACCTID FROM PTL_CAPACCT_INFO P LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO S ON P.ACCT_NO = S.ACCT_NO where P.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND P.ACCT_TYPE = #{acctType} and rownum=1

SELECT TPD.TRADE_ID TRADE_ID, BUSI_TYPE BUSI_TYPE, FINPROD_ID FINPROD_ID, FINPROD_TYPE FINPROD_TYPE, FINPROD_TYPE2 FINPROD_TYPE2, BRANCH BRANCH, TRADE_DATE TRADE_DATE, VDATE VDATE, MDATE MDATE, SETTLE_DATE SETTLE_DATE, SETTLE_SPEED SETTLE_SPEED, CCY CCY, CPRICE_DATE CPRICE_DATE, UNIT_CPRICE UNIT_CPRICE, UNIT_INT UNIT_INT, UNIT_FPRICE UNIT_FPRICE, PAR_VALUE PAR_VALUE, CPRICE_AMT CPRICE_AMT, case when TPD.PS != 'T07' and (FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F02' or FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F03') then SHARE_AMT WHEN FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' THEN SHARE_AMT else SHARE_AMT*100 end SHARE_AMT, PRIN_AMT PRIN_AMT, INT_AMT INT_AMT, FPRICE_AMT FPRICE_AMT, FEE_AMT_PAY FEE_AMT_PAY, TRADE_AMT TRADE_AMT, FEE_AMT_UNPAY FEE_AMT_UNPAY, FEE_AMT FEE_AMT, PS PS, YIELD YIELD, EXER_YIELD EXER_YIELD, INV_AIM INV_AIM, TRADE_STATUS TRADE_STATUS, IS_CANCEL IS_CANCEL, P_TRADE_ID P_TRADE_ID, IS_CLEAN IS_CLEAN, TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID TOTLE_TRADE_ID, R_TRADE_ID R_TRADE_ID, B_TRADE_ID B_TRADE_ID, CHL_ID CHL_ID, COUNTER_ID COUNTER_ID, IS_OUT_TRADE IS_OUT_TRADE, TRADE_MARKET TRADE_MARKET, TRADE_PLAT TRADE_PLAT, TRADE_MARKET_MODE TRADE_MARKET_MODE, TRADER TRADER, COUNTER_TRADER COUNTER_TRADER, COUNTER_CONTACT COUNTER_CONTACT, SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, F_TRADE_ID F_TRADE_ID, CASH_ID CASH_ID, REGIST_ORG REGIST_ORG, REMARK REMARK, CANCEL_REMARK CANCEL_REMARK, DELIVERY_TYPE DELIVERY_TYPE, PAY_DATE PAY_DATE, SALE_CODE SALE_CODE, ACCR_NUM ACCR_NUM, TG_BUSI_TYPE TG_BUSI_TYPE, PS_PAYMENT PS_PAYMENT, SEAT_ID SEAT_ID, SETTLEMEN_TYPE SETTLEMEN_TYPE, TPDA.PORTFOLIO_ID, TPDA.ENTRUST_ID, TPDA.OUR_SHARE_AMT, TPDA.LENDIN_SHARE_AMT FROM TRD_PRODUCT_TEMP_DEAL TPD LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_TEMP_DEAL_ADD TPDA ON TPD.TRADE_ID = TPDA.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD TDTA ON TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TDTA.TOTLE_TRADE_ID WHERE TPD.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT V.SEC_ACCT_ID AS SECACCTID FROM PTL_SEC_ACCT PSA, STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO V LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT R ON R.REGIST_ORG = V.REGIST_ORG WHERE PSA.ACCT_NO = V.SEC_ACCT_ID AND V.SEC_ACCT_TYPE = 'SEC' AND V.TRADE_PLACE in ('01','02') AND V.TRADE_PLACE = R.TRADE_MARKET AND PSA.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND R.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT T1.INV_AIM FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION T1 WHERE T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} /*and 持仓类型 = 数据字典缓存.持仓类型.实际*/
AND T1.HODING_TYPE IN ( '03', '05', '06', '11' ) /*and 组合持仓.日期 = 平台日*/
AND t1.CDATE < TO_DATE(#{mDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T1.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{secAcctId} AND T1.AMOUNT > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION tpsp WHERE tpsp.HODING_TYPE = T1.HODING_TYPE AND tpsp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID AND tpsp.SEC_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID AND tpsp.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND tpsp.CDATE > T1.CDATE AND tpsp.CDATE < TO_DATE(#{mDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ) ORDER BY T1.CDATE DESC) where rownum=1

SELECT T1.TRADE_ID finprodId, T1.CCY, T4.BASIS, T4.INT_RATE*100 INT_RATE, to_char(T4.MPAY_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mpayDate, T1.COUNTER_ID, T6.COUNTER_NAME, T1.COUNTER_TRADER, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, null REMARK, T1.TRADER, T4.FINPROD_ID, T3.PORTFOLIO_ID, SUBT2.PORTFOLIO_ID ACT_PORTFOLIO_ID, SUBT2.PORTFOLIO_NAME, T5.TYPE_6,
T1.CHL_ID,
T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 , to_char(T1.TRADE_DATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') TRADE_DATE, to_char(T4.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') vDate/*计息开始日*/, to_char(T4.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') mDate/*计息结束日*/, T4.TERM,/*回购期限*/ T1.PRIN_AMT THEORY_PRIN/*理论本金*/, T1.TRADE_MARKET TRADE_MARKET, null SETTLE_DATE,
T4.M_INT_AMT THEORY_INT/*理论利息*/, T4.M_TRADE_AMT THEORY_AMT,/*理论本息总额*/
null TRADE_AMT ,T1.COUNTER_CONTACT counterContact/*联系方式*/ ,T1.PRIN_AMT ,T1.FEE_AMT_UNPAY ,T1.FEE_AMT ,T1.P_TRADE_ID ,T1.IS_CLEAN ,T1.TRADE_PLAT ,T1.TRADE_MARKET_MODE ,T1.DELIVERY_TYPE ,T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID ,T1.UNIT_INT ,T1.SETTLE_SPEED ,T7.SHARE_AMT SHARE_AMT ,tpda.ENTRUST_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda on t1.TRADE_ID = tpda.TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE T3 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T3.BUSI_NO
LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE T31 ON T1.TRADE_ID = T31.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO SUBT2 ON SUBT2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T31.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FCI ON T1.FINPROD_ID = FCI.FINPROD_ID AND T1.CCY = FCI.CCY AND FCI.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{C02} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN FCP ON FCI.CASH_ID = FCP.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T5 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN MST_COUNTER_PARTY T6 ON T1.COUNTER_ID = T6.COUNTER_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUM(PLEDGE_NUMBER) SHARE_AMT, FINPROD_ID FROM FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE GROUP BY FINPROD_ID) T7 ON T7.FINPROD_ID = T1.TRADE_ID WHERE T1.BUSI_TYPE = #{COMMON_BUSINESS_TYPETRD08} and t1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} and t1.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} AND T1.PS = #{PS_T01} AND T2.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID IS NULL AND SUBT2.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID AND TPD.PS IN (#{PST22}, #{PST23}) AND TPD.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN (#{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF02}, #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF03}) and TPD.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} and TPD.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID ) AND T1.TRADE_ID = #{finprodId}
